purpose: Test the proposed month-resampling percentile interval itself after simpler block-Student diagnostics exposed remaining dependence
blocks: 12 equally sized consecutive blocks of 21 synthetic sessions; not an exact exchange-month calendar
primary_diagnostic: fraction of true-zero means excluded by the two-sided 95% percentile interval resampling 12 whole blocks with replacement
limitation: This is a controlled counterexample, not the false-positive rate of the full Factor Intelligence or S6 production pipeline. No FDR or practical-effect gate is modeled.
